evidence: py_compile passed for q3_pretask_optimizer.py and q3_run_round2.py.
The round-2 runner completed twice without exception.
Initial positions and headings are interpreted at each UAV availability time a_i, not unconditionally at t=0.
Selected availability times are clipped to [-60,0] s and predeployment routes are simulated to the release events.
Every result retains SYNTHETIC_SCENARIO_ONLY.
Q3-A is the main Pareto search, Q3-B is the mandatory constructive baseline, and Q3-C remains absent.
Normal full-window defense is screened before secondary objectives.
Path length and turn angle remain separate objectives with no invented weight.
Two consecutive runs produced byte-identical main, baseline, safety, Pareto and CSV evidence artifacts.
The deterministic seed and runtime environment are recorded in run_summary.json.
The run emits the Pareto front, safety-distance sweep, lead-time sweep, A/B comparison, validation records and diagnostic figure.
No representative candidate is auto-selected because the three approved rules disagree.
A-00017, A-00033, A-00217 and A-00829 pass adaptive continuous-time envelope validation.

No N-1 full-window candidate found is explicitly not an impossibility proof.
The old probe-only 864 candidates and 127.73 m are excluded.
